result:
All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers. I checked a few of them by hand against the data (U7 average 94, U9 tools 16.08 and decor 14.5, and the U14 word counts).

- **Output format:** U9 prints with `:tools`-style keys, because the output is qlang notation, not JSON. U8, U9, U10 and U13 used `--raw`. U14 uses a literal, so it needs no input.
- **U2 rounding:** I round with `mul 100 | round | div 100`, because I didn't check whether `round` takes a decimals argument. It answered 69.93.
- **U5:** The three-way tie at count 2 resolves by login ascending, giving abe, kim, lee.

U1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf (at :active | eq true) (at :address | ne null)) | filter ~(/address | at :city | ne null) | filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
U3: filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: :m / | [(m | /dependencies | entries) (m | /devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
U5: filter ~(at :state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: map ~(at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
U7: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | take (count | sub 2) | parseJson) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
U8: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :c /1}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)
U9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) | map ~(map ~(/2 | parseJson) | avg | mul 100 | round | div 100)
U10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | ne 0) | map ~({:n /0 :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) | take 3 | map ~(/n)
U11: :d /defaults | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :s /1}) | map ~({:name /name :en (/s | at :enabled | coalesce (d | /enabled)) :port (/s | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | filter ~(/en | ne false) | map ~({:name /name :port /port}) | sort ~(/name)
U12: groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(sort ~(/ts) | last | /type)
U13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | eq false) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | lower | split "," | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","fig","Elderberry","cherry","Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | :w / | {:count (w | count) :longest (w | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
